text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I came to the shrine to pray together 
with Verxina, who has been feeling a bit 
out of sorts lately—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what these books piled up here 
are?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm airing them out in the shade. 
There are still more inside, but my back's 
started acting up... Ouch, ouch.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Um. If you'd like, shall I carry the 
rest of the books?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Coming to worship here must surely be 
destiny. Allow me to assist you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After getting permission from the head 
priest to enter the shrine building, the 
two of them split up to carry out the 
books."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm done with my part. How are 
things on your end, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
This is the last one over here too... 
Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I lift the stack of books, a large bug 
flies out from behind them. It buzzes 
around me threateningly, relentlessly 
circling my head.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina gave her tail a sharp *swish*, as 
if firing herself up—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Take this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a swift flick of Verxina's tail, the 
bug hastily fled outside.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, Trainer. They're already 
gone.
choice_data_list:
Amazing, you seemed really used to doing 
that!
Amazing, you seemed really used to that!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much. Actually, I 
often go outdoors with my family, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Gyanyaaaaa~~~~!!?? A bug! A huge one!! Big 
sisss~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! Just leave it to your big 
sis!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"—And so it went. Thanks to that, I've 
gotten completely used to it."
choice_data_list:
I see, so you got strong to protect your 
little sister, huh?

I see, you became strong to protect your 
little sister, huh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, that's about the size of it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That should be everything brought out. 
...Oh? What's that—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Found you, Big Sister~~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos. Cheval. Did you two come to pray 
as well?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No... Mom and the others were talking 
about having dinner together. And so...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"You came all the way out to meet me! 
Fufu, thank you, both of you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After a heartwarming walk home with her 
little sisters, Verxina's condition 
improved noticeably from that day onward!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing unpacking all the books, I 
took a breath. Just then, an ominous 
buzzing sound reached my ears...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —...!? Trainer, look at that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could they be friends of that insect from 
before...? A swarm of bugs is approaching, 
emitting a low buzzing sound...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Taking on that many opponents might be 
impossible after all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We were chased by bugs and had a terrible 
time... Even after that, Verxina's 
condition didn't recover...
